title: Genetically Modified Crops: Fact vs Fiction Explained 15 Years In Nigeria 2022
reason: The transcript discusses the introduction and characteristics of genetically modified crops.

tasks.task: Explain the need for genetically modified crops in Kenya.

subtasks.text: The government argues Kenya needs to adopt genetically modified crops to become food-secure.
The reduction in corn production in Kenya from 2018 to 2022 is attributed to the lack of certain pest-resistant varieties.

tasks.task: Present scientific evidence against the need for genetically modified crops.

subtasks.text: A report by FAO states the drop in corn production was primarily due to drought.
Genetic modification is described as a laboratory-based technique different from traditional breeding.

tasks.task: Describe the process of genetic modification.

subtasks.text: Tissue from the plant is cultured in labs to insert desired genes.
The process involves uncertainty and potential risks to the genetic makeup of plants.
Regulations on genetically modified crops are not uniform.
An example of potential risks is given, mentioning that radiation-induced mutations can be even more mutagenic.
